references.text: The introduction to the chapter mentioning the LORD's feasts and holy assemblies, using the same terminology as in verse 37
A parallel summary of the LORD's feasts and holy assemblies that are to be proclaimed
Detailed instructions regarding daily offerings, burnt offerings, and drink offerings to be brought to the LORD
Concluding summary in Numbers concerning the festival offerings: burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings, and peace offerings
Instructions regarding the daily burnt offering to be offered regularly for the LORD
Basic instructions concerning the burnt offering (עֹלָה) as a fire offering to the LORD
Instructions concerning the grain offering (מִנְחָה) mentioned in the verse
Instructions concerning the peace offering/sacrifice of slaughter (זֶבַח) mentioned in the verse
Detailed instructions regarding drink offerings (נְסָכִים) that were to accompany the sacrifices
Ezra celebrates the feasts and brings offerings in accordance with the daily requirement, as prescribed
